split-transaction-writes: NOT_APPLICABLE, The transactions panel, whose evidence this reads, is not available in this application: transaction boundary capture relies on Spring Framework's TransactionExecutionListener hook, registered against ConfigurableTransactionManager beans. Quarkus's transaction management goes through Narayana's JTA TransactionManager/Synchronization or the CDI @Transactional interceptor, neither of which exposes a comparable per-boundary listener without far more invasive instrumentation, so this panel is not used here.
